column1: # Every third-party component the app and the web page ship, and the files that carry its licence.
# **The last column says which build carries it**: `app`, `web`, or both. One table for the two,
# because the decoders are the same code in both and two tables would drift apart version by
# version (`docs/PLAN_WEB_PARITY.md` W-D1). The page's engine has no UADE and none of Android; the
# app has no Emscripten runtime and no QR library of the page's.
# **Read at build time and at run time, and nowhere else.** `app/build.gradle.kts` copies the listed
# files into the APK's assets under `notices/<id>/`, and the Settings screen "Open-source licences"
# shows them -- so the text a user reads is the text that came with the code, not a retelling of it.
# BSD, MIT and Apache ask for exactly that: the notice reproduced with the binary.
# `NoticesCoverTheBuildTest` fails when a decoder is built by `native/CMakeLists.txt` and has no `app`
# row here, and when a listed file does not exist; `scripts/check-page.mjs` fails when the web engine
# links something with no `web` row. `scripts/stage-web-legal.mjs` copies the `web` rows beside the

column5: files, comma-separated, relative to the repository

column2: Emscripten runtime, musl libc and libc++, compiled into the web engine
column4: MIT or NCSA (Emscripten), MIT (musl), Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception (libc++)
